mapper.sql: select id, user_id, user_name, nick_name, dept_id, dept_name, latitude, longitude, address, clockin_type, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from hms_clockin_record
mapper.insert: insert into hms_clockin_record ( user_id, user_name, nick_name, dept_id, dept_name, latitude, longitude, address, clockin_type, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{address}, #{clockinType}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select:
SELECT DATE(cr.create_time) AS clockinDate, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.user_id) AS clockinCount FROM hms_clockin_record cr WHERE cr.user_id IN ( SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = 105 )
AND cr.create_time >= #{beginDate}
AND cr.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(cr.create_time) ORDER BY clockinDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = 105

SELECT cr.user_id AS userId, cr.user_name AS userName, cr.nick_name AS nickName, cr.dept_name AS deptName, MIN(cr.create_time) AS firstClockinTime, MAX(cr.create_time) AS lastClockinTime, COUNT(1) AS clockinCount FROM hms_clockin_record cr WHERE cr.user_id IN ( SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = 105 ) AND DATE(cr.create_time) = #{date} GROUP BY cr.user_id, cr.user_name, cr.nick_name, cr.dept_name ORDER BY firstClockinTime

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.user_id IN ( SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = 105 ) AND u.user_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT cr.user_id FROM hms_clockin_record cr WHERE DATE(cr.create_time) = #{date} ) ORDER BY u.user_name

SELECT cr.id, cr.user_id AS userId, cr.user_name AS userName, cr.nick_name AS nickName, cr.dept_name AS deptName, cr.clockin_type AS clockinType, cr.create_time AS clockinTime, cr.address, cr.latitude, cr.longitude FROM hms_clockin_record cr WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(cr.create_time) = #{date} ORDER BY cr.create_time
